# Missing Configuration File Error Handling

The read_config function raises a CompileError if the expected configuration file (kc.toml) is not found in the specified directory. This may lead to runtime errors if not handled appropriately in higher layers of the application.

- `knowledge_compiler/compiler/run.py` — `knowledge_compiler.compiler.run.read_config`
